items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Because old man Cousteau, he used to arrange a little bit, not much.

ctx.x: Would that be Emmanuel Cousteau's father? No, I don't know. You know him? Well I guess he's after your time. I think he was born in 1918 or something like that. I heard him the other night, the young Cousteau is playing progressive jazz now. We heard him the other night with a big band. He was playing with the Royal Dukes of Rhythm now.
Because old man Cousteau, he used to arrange a little bit, not much. Which one? This fellow was a good arranger.
Which Cousteau is this? I don't understand. That's Louis, Louis Cousteau.
